taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-06 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 857.1 | 0.64 | 0.64
2 | 996.7 | 0.52 | 1.16
3 | 83.1 | 1.53 | 2.69
4 | 335.1 | 3.03 | 5.72
5 | 27.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-06
Curve type: KHK
Aquifer depth: 1.16–2.69 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone (Layer 3, 83.1 ohm-m) between 1.16 m and 2.69 m depth for screen placement, as it likely represents a saturated, permeable horizon sandwiched between more resistive layers. Case off the overlying resistive layers (0–1.16 m) during drilling, and note that the underlying conductive layer below 5.72 m (27.9 ohm-m) may represent clay/weathered basement rather than a productive aquifer.
